frontier.notes: exact hybrid 21-cell profile; cross-family cells use Arena r1-r3 and reused cells retain their original validated route/epoch · 2/21 observations are nondominated on the empirical means · large filled/labeled = frontier · small open = dominated · icon = harness · Pareto membership is descriptive; intervals show uncertainty and can overlap · cost is token usage repriced under one frozen price schedule (agentbrane-research-2026-09-01-v3) so systems billed through different routes stay comparable; it need not equal what was actually paid · bootstrap frequency is not a posterior probability · The cost axis is logarithmic because the included systems span more than three orders of magnitude. The Arena cross-family cells (Claude Fable 5 · Codex, Claude Haiku 4.5 · Codex, Claude Opus 4.8 · Codex, Claude Sonnet 4.6 · Codex, GPT-5.6 Luna · Claude Code, GPT-5.6 Sol · Claude Code, Kimi K3 · Claude Code, Kimi K3 · Codex) contain 3 repetitions run through the Arena serving route in a later execution epoch than the existing cells. They are drawn, labelled and hovered exactly like every other system; their resolved-rate and cost intervals are the same task-cluster percentile bootstrap (10,000 draws, repetitions averaged within task) every other cell carries, computed by the dashboard from the published task outcomes. The hybrid publication plan makes no test or ranking claim for them, and route or execution epoch may confound comparisons with the existing cells.
